place.en: The deeps of Lake Lei · The middle of the lake

setup.zh: 水分开了。湖底的泥里卧着一口鼎，鼎口盖着一张石板，板上刻着河图：一六在北，二七在南，四九在西，五十在中——东边空着。
setup.en: The water parts. In the mud of the lakebed lies a cauldron, its mouth covered by a stone slab cut with the River Chart: one and six in the north, two and seven in the south, four and nine in the west, five and ten at the heart — and the east left blank.

text.zh: 河图。冀州那口用的是洛书，这口用的是河图。
text.en: The River Chart. The one in Ji was sealed with the Luo square; this one with the River Chart.

label.en: Read the seal · Fill the east

exits.means: reads the seal, answers which numbers belong in the east

text.zh: 你在东边写下答案。石板从中裂开，两半沉进泥里。鼎口的气息冲上来，带着雷味和桑叶味。
text.en: You write the answer in the east. The slab splits down the middle and both halves sink into the mud. The cauldron's breath rushes up, thunder and mulberry leaf.

exits.means: tries to break, lift or pry the slab by force

text.zh: 石板不动。河图的数在你掌下一亮一暗，像心跳。
text.en: The slab does not move. Under your palm the numbers of the Chart brighten and dim, like a heartbeat.
